ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light grey/white mottling blobs localized on the distal regions of both lobes, with dark focal spots embedded within the lighter regions; solid dark pigmentation dominates the central fluke and trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45-50 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially occluded by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (small peaks and valleys) extracted along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory mapped along the trailing edges toward the central notch; leading edges exhibit a primary convex curvature tapering to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (rosettes) detected on the light-pigmented sections of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of dark circular pigmentation spots/scars distributed across the lighter ventral surface regions.
